notes.title: SUMMER CAMP IS HELL - INTRODUCING HELL CAMP!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/2cc072f982861fe32f038e42b5e39ae5d20f3da7.jpg[/img]

An all-new crew of unsuspecting counsellors-in-training are invited to a counsellor training session in preparation of their summer at HELL CAMP. It’s not long before they learn that the one hosting the camp training is none other than sinister Skullface, now in HOLY ANGELIC FORM. It’s also shortly thereafter that they discover the horrifying discovery that the training session is located in the fiery pits of HELL.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/38a184fe9d3bac3d37ef25736264ae5e82af9a1b.jpg[/img]

Not a single unsaved soul stands a chance against Skullface who disregards the entire camp training plot-line to slice and dice his way through all nine circles of hell and make his way to the poorly decorated bedroom of Satan himself. Every time a bell rings an angel gets his wings and this time... the bell tolls for thee.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/d29baa645172a4b8e8cf2cc729ab4181f0b4d9d0.jpg[/img]

In celebration of the HORRORS of HALLOWEEN, Hell Camp is a FREE UPDATE to all players of the base game today! Hell Camp will emerge from the depths of hades once you've completed the first 3 movies in Slayaway Camp!

[h1]NEW KILLERS![/h1]

In addition to the horrific update featuring puzzles from the 9 circles of hell, we are also unleashing some new killers! Holy Skullface will automatically unlock as the star of the new movie, plus both Alien Beast + Pumpkin Face are now shoved uncomfortably within the confines of the Mystery Box. Use those hard-earned Skull Coins to unlock them in the new update—all 3 come with their own hilarious Gorepack special kills!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/ebfc524d0a561facb5fafd4d826b53fffd02a0c3.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/41e456d12e582ac58fb1cfbb64a73318e3eaa1c3.gif[/img]

[h1]SLASHBACK VIDEO![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/ccb9df15836f8f09db04b8912742086d6a0848b4.jpg[/img]

Also in support of Mystic Museum and Ryan Turek, we've created a super special Killer Kode ([b]slashback[/b]) that will unlock the "TapeHead" killer featured in the "Slashback Video" Horror Movie Art Gallery + VHS Video Store installation in Burbank California.

If you're in Burbank, check out the installation it features tons of horror memorabilia, art, and in a setting true to the period: an ultra rad nostalgia-laced video store.

[h1]THANKS![/h1]

That's all for now, but stay tuned because in just ONE WEEK, we drop our brand new Monthly Murderer to players signed up at http://www.slayawaycamp.com. This month the campers will want to make sure they've got their wrist rockets handy!

Until then, enjoy those flaming pits of PUZZLE HELL!!!

Love,
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/17269971cc4c0b87fc406c20eb82a46f08755606.png[/img]
Skullface + The Slayaway Team ːskullfaceːːslayawaycleaverː
www.slayawaycamp.com

P.S. We leave you with this final Halloween treat: a special promo video recorded by our amazing community members: Mr. Candyworm and Batprince!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ym2Jt4FhXnA

notes.title: SOME BUG FIXES!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/ddd2959f750a6a61caccaddfc645b9d912119d95.gif[/img]

Hey Killers! 

Wanted to post a special update today that fixes some bugs and prepares for something special to be coming very soon. Here's a quick rundown of what you can expect:

[list]
[*] BUGFIX: we had this weird issue where sometimes after a bonus kill the game would go to a black screen. This was due to the darkness of the universe coagulating in your computer device causing its internal circuitry to not know what to do next with its life... We input some code to help your computer come to terms with the meaninglessness of the universe and so the black screen no longer happens.
[*] [strike]NEW FEATURE - Randomize Killer! You can now select an option from the options menu that will randomize the killer you're using every time a new level begins. Do this when you have a bunch of killers and want to add some more surprises to your already surprisey life! [/strike] (Had to pull this for now as it was having some issues and we didnt want the other fixes to wait while we fixed those issues.)
[*] NEW LOCALIZATION! You can now play the game in Simplified Chinese. We're working on getting the store page text converted as well, but for now feel free to switch to Chinese in the language selector!
[*] NEW FEATURE: "Message Window" - we've added a special notification window that appears on the shelf screen with any important announcements, game updates, new content, or emergency information. It's pretty integrated right into the game, basically the Tombkeeper pops up to tell you a thing. We have setup a one-time announcement for the PS4/XBox version just to inform players who don't normally check the forums, etc. Once you have seen a message you wont be shown it again, so no worries about eternal spamness or anything horribly horrific like that. We'll also try to use it to give you some special holiday killer kodes from time to time etc. :) 
[*] LEVEL CHANGE: Movie 8 - Deleted Scene #2 (changed layout of level)
[*] PLUS: More bug fixes, optimizations and SUPER ULTIMATE SECURITY updates to make your time in Slayaway Camp more enjoyable and stable across the board.
[/list]

These update should now be available! Keep your eyes peeled for a very special announcement coming on Friday the 13th... that's next week! (http://www.slayawaycamp.com)

ːskullfaceːːslayawaycleaverː

Hope everyone is having a killer summer, and those camp counsellors are not too much trouble to deal with!

We've posted a new build of Slayaway Camp but its pretty unexciting in the greater scheme, just fixes some weird lil bugs that have been gathering up over time. Hope it makes your Slayaway Camp experience all the more smooth and enjoyable!

Happy Slaying! ːskullfaceːːslayawayknifeː

notes.title: The 'OMG WOW EVEN MORE BUGFIXES!' Update (v1.6.7)
notes.content:
Hey Killers! We wanted to make sure to squash a few smaller but annoying bugs that have been plaguing users.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/58fba9dc8ae3eae4386576acd57229103390eccc.jpg[/img]

We're going to be launching on Android tomorrow so hooray! Also a huge update to iOS (and Android Launch of course) where we are finally able to bring those much coveted deleted scenes and all their flavour text. notes.content:

Hey you savage bunch of puzzle solving psychopaths! Today is a very special day in that we're releasing our first ever [b]PREMIUM KILLER DLC Pack ːslayawayknifeː[/b]. This pack features 6 brand new killers we think are the coolest looking killers we've ever made in the history of the existing universe!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/637001/Slayaway_Camp__Supernatural_Forces_Killer_Pack/

[h1]FLAMING SKULLFACE[/h1]
Nothing says 'I'm pure evil, bro, so step off.' like wearing a leather jacket and having a head that is eternally engulfed in flames. Comes with his super badass special kill: CHOPPERED.

[h1]SUPERNATURAL OCCURRENCE[/h1]
Typically only visible in handy cam night vision, this supernatural spirit is the epitome of shadowy darkness. Comes with their super special kill: DISINHABITED & apply's a hard-mode night vision filter across the full game.

[h1]WRAITH[/h1]
Tired of waiting for people's time to die, this wraith has taken the cause into his own hands. Hovers above the ground with a floaty cloak of pure unimaginable darkness. Comes with his super special kill: FAILED SAVING THROW.

[h1]SUMERIAN DEMON[/h1]
Your run of the mill, average, every-day hell-spawn Sumerian demon with the heaviest of heavy metal animated flaming wings. Comes with its super special kill: TOASTY!

[h1]YETI[/h1]
A mountain snow beast come down from the icy slopes to smash some heads in. Features real patented RasterVox™ fur and brutally frozen falling ice crystals of death. Comes with its super special kill: SNOW JOKE!

[h1]PLUS: KEVIN[/h1]
It's... just... well.. It's Kevin.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/637001/Slayaway_Camp__Supernatural_Forces_Killer_Pack/

[h1]MONTHLY MURDERERS SERIES 1![/h1]

We've also posted a collected pack of Monthly Murderers (Series 1) for purchase. We were about to fire Nate for spending all his time replying to players about the previously released Killer Kodes, and not getting any actual work done. 

In a desperate plea to keep his job, he proposed we put the past Killer Kodes up as a DLC pack for anyone who missed out. 

Be sure to stay signed up to the Monthly Murderer Club / Mailing list at www.slayawaycamp.com -- also add slayawaycamp@bluewizard.com to your address book to make sure none of the emails go to your spam folder. Because if you email Nate asking for missed codes, we will be asking him to pack up his things into a sad, water stained and ripped brown cardboard box.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/637000/Slayaway_Camp__Monthly_Murderers_Series_1/

[h1]ALSO, BUG FIXES![/h1] 

We also made some minor bug fixes in this update. Here are the details of those fixes:
[list]
[*] There was a strange issue where DLC Gorepacks were occupying the same shelf space and time of normal gorepacks. Their molecular structures were intermingled so purely they made an all new super gorepack, but it caused sever inter-dimensional instability and so we had to put a stop to it. They should now appear on the shelf properly.
[*] There was a slight audio click that occurred when you pause the game to go to the shelf, and then back again. This click has been smoothed out into something more of a ___ now. Do enjoy.
[*] The shadows looked a little like a potato was generating them. We've improved them slightly so they now look more like McDonalds Fries generated them. We'll get them to the point where it looks like Potato Salad with Egg generated them, soon enough.
[*] Improved movement input response time.
[/list]

[b]PLUS:[/b] We've been working hard to lay the groundwork for a full Simplified Chinese localization. That should be coming within the next month, and will feature some cool new chinese killers, Jianshi & The Killer Kung Fu Panda. Not to mention... Android is on the way soon, too! We will have a special announcement on the Android Release Date any day now :)

Happy Slaying!
The Slayaway Team ːskullfaceːːslayawayknifeː

Hey Killers! We hope your spring is full of stuff that has sprung. We have been working hard on the Android release of the game and getting it ready to launch in closed beta very soon, but also have been making sure we have some cool stuff coming for Steam too, starting with a quick update that fixes some small issues that you have kindly reported to us! For your patience and kindness, Skullface will kill you last.

[h1]SWEET NEW DLC'S COMING SOON!![/h1]

We've got some great new stuff coming up over the next month or so as well, including the [b]SUPERNATURAL FORCES KILLER PACK[/b]: a brand new DLC Pack of premium Killers for just $2 USD.

[b]Super Sweet Supernatural Psycho Killers Include:[/b]
[list]
[*] FLAMING SKULLFACE
[*] SUMERIAN DEMON
[*] SUPERNATURAL OCCURRENCE 
[*] WRAITH
[*] YETI
[*] PLUS.... kevin
[/list]

Each killer has a special premium effect, and comes with their very own special Gorepack kill animation. We'll have some more info on it all very soon!

[h1]OK OK WHAT ABOUT THE UPDATE TODAY?[/h1]

Last but not least, here is a changelog for todays patches:

[list]
[*] There was an issue where music would stop, frozen in fear of an unspeakable kill animation taking place and would never return. We've talked to the music gently with our gentle voices so it's not so afraid anymore.
[*] We've Improved the UI on the Deleted Scenes menus. Should be more pleasing to your retinas now. Or maybe you don't even notice, in which case we've wasted our time, haven't we? We haven't.

[*] If you tried to pause while the Tombkeeper's walkthrough was 'rewinding' itself, you could essentially freeze your voxel killer in its tracks, forever doomed to a rewinding space in the infinitum of space and time. We've resolved this issues so your killer can now kill like a killer should kill.
[*] We fired the kid working at SKULL VIDEO (the video store on the movie shelf screen). He was a stoner / slacker and kept putting the DLC tapes in weird spots. You know what we said to him? Hey Killers! We hope your spring is full of stuff that has sprung. We have been working hard on the Android release of the game and getting it ready to launch in closed beta very soon, but also have been making sure we have some cool stuff coming for Steam too, starting with a quick update that fixes some small issues that you have kindly reported to us! For your patience and kindness, Skullface will kill you last.

[h1]SWEET NEW DLC'S COMING SOON!![/h1]

We've got some great new stuff coming up over the next month or so as well, including the [b]SUPERNATURAL FORCES KILLER PACK[/b]: a brand new DLC Pack of premium Killers for just $2 USD.

[b]Super Sweet Supernatural Psycho Killers Include:[/b]
[list]
[*] FLAMING SKULLFACE
[*] SUMERIAN DEMON
[*] SUPERNATURAL OCCURRENCE 
[*] WRAITH
[*] YETI
[*] PLUS.... kevin
[/list]

Each killer has a special premium effect, and comes with their very own special Gorepack kill animation. We'll have some more info on it all very soon!

[h1]OK OK WHAT ABOUT THE UPDATE TODAY?[/h1]

Last but not least, here is a changelog for todays patches:

[list]
[*] There was an issue where music would stop, frozen in fear of an unspeakable kill animation taking place and would never return. We've talked to the music gently with our gentle voices so it's not so afraid anymore.
[*] We've Improved the UI on the Deleted Scenes menus. Should be more pleasing to your retinas now. Or maybe you don't even notice, in which case we've wasted our time, haven't we? We haven't.
[*] The pause button appeared while a level was loading but you couldn't hit it until the level had actually loaded. This was weird. So we told the pause button to get the hell out of here until the level had actually fully loaded and it seems to have listened.
[*] If you tried to pause while the Tombkeeper's walkthrough was 'rewinding' itself, you could essentially freeze your voxel killer in its tracks, forever doomed to a rewinding space in the infinitum of space and time. We've resolved this issues so your killer can now kill like a killer should kill.
[*] We fired the kid working at SKULL VIDEO (the video store on the movie shelf screen). He was a stoner / slacker and kept putting the DLC tapes in weird spots. You know what we said to him? We said "You're Fired" and we did this thing with our fingers like we were plucking a raspberry off an imaginary bush in front of our big orange face. We hired a new kid and she's awesome with the video tapes. Puts them where they're supposed to go all the time. Amazing worker. The best. The best worker.
[*] There was a gorepack in the Santa's Slay DLC that had the wrong name. Well. Blah blah blah. Now it has the right name.
[*] The Lawn Mower Gorepack (Party's Over) Was not loading. Im sure this angered Peter Jackson greatly, so we fixed it. It is now fixed. You're welcome, Peter Jackson.
[/list]

Still working through a couple more bug fixes but didn't want to hold these ones back too much longer so there we go! :slayawayaxe:

Thanks All, Happy Slaying!
The Slayaway Team :skullface: :slayawayknife:

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/9cda371bd9d8069b9d2a9b8155ec85a5ac9bfc87.gif[/img]

Happy Easter Everyone! We wanted to put out a small but special Easter update for you all! The Easter content is exclusive to the Steam version for now so enjoy the first access to some sweet easter treats!

[h1]v1.6 CHANGELOG[/h1]

[list]
[*] Sweet new Easter Content! Use the Killer Kode "[b]beaster[/b]" to unlock the Feaster Bunny on your killer shelf! Feaster Bunny comes with an all-new special killer kill: EASTER BUNNIED

[*] Also included is a new purchase-able gorepack: DEATH BY CHOCOLATE & a killer bunny rabbit bonus kill!

[*] Not only that, we've hidden a very special easter egg in one of the movie's deleted scenes section - drop a comment if you tracked it down! :)

[*] All-new PG (Puzzle Game) Mode scrubs away every ounce of blood, gore, and general horror movie havoc to let squeamish players focus on solving the mind-melting puzzles in relative safety.

[*] PG Mode unlocks the “Yo! Skullface! After School Special” bonus mini-game, which is really just the Faces of Killed mini-game, but features Skullface practicing his murderous technique on inanimate archery targets.

[*] Updates to Movie Store tutorial to make the Mystery Box more obvious and the tutorial process a little more straightforward.

[*] Improved timing and general well-being of animations when viewing Gorepacks from the Movie Store shelf.

[*] Visual Soundwaves now emit from the phones to give a better idea of what tiles they affect when they ring.

[*] When you turn the lights off, victims and cops get a skinny cloud of darkness around their heads, hopefully helping to illustrate the fact that they are SITTING DUCKS WAITING FOR YOUR MACHETE!!!!!

[*] Disable the shop shelf from being accessible before the tutorial, just to avoid confusing new players.

[*] Cleaned up Gore sliders a bit to avoid bugs and confusion. Single Gorosity slider should now increase blood, bones and gibs overall or reduce blood bones and gibs down to nothing (but still getting cutscenes). Can turn ALL the way to the left to switch to PG Mode.

[*] Moved Gorosity Slider and Killer Kode button to the top area, so they are easier to track down for new users.

[*] New “Movie Complete” Sound effect for more aural stimulations.

[*] Improved font visibility across full game UI / Cutscenes.

[*] A few additional optimizations and minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Happy Slaying! ːskullfaceːːslayawayknifeː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/17014d0dfbebf73bffbe14146daab3f15db76df0.gif[/img]

ːskullfaceː Hey Killers!! 

Some of you may have already noticed, but we've posted a very special new update for Slayaway Camp that introduces a tonne of new content to your camp puzzle-slaughter exploits.

[h1]GOREPACKS GALORE![/h1]

We've made it now so that every time you unlock a new killer, you also unlock their super special kill animation. You can see their special animation while playing only with that killer, and it becomes part of the normal rotation while you use that killer. We've got some hilarious ones in there like the JIMSAW Killer 'Cornered' kill, the Derek Mears 'Unborned' kill, etc. We hope you dig these new kills!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/79a17d2c4cf84600248d72e9e432d74967d3e39c.gif[/img]

[h1]INTRODUCING BATPRINCE![/h1]

As the winner of our #SkullfaceAndMe contest to become a special in-game killer, Youtuber 'Batprince' has been immortalized as one of the newest in-game killers. Batprince can come up in the mystery box so save up those skull coins for a chance to unlock him and his awesome 'POLITELY KILLED' gorepack!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/ddd2959f750a6a61caccaddfc645b9d912119d95.gif[/img]

[h1]1.5 CHANGELOG[/h1]

In addition to these updates, we've made some other tweaks, bug fixes and other changes based on your awesome feedback. Here's a list of what was done:

[list]
[*] Update to shelf tutorial to make Mystery Box more obvious and the tutorial process a little more clear.
[*] Fixes to some textures that had become distorted
[*] Improved timing on animations when viewing gorepacks from the shelf
[*] Fixed issue with excessive beeping in menu scene when using a scroll wheel or track pad
[*] Additional minor bug fixes. Like the one where that level, the bad thing happens. We made it so it doesnt anymore.
[/list]

If you notice anything that needs a tweak, don't hesitate to drop us a line either in the comments here, or via email: slayawaycamp@bluewizard.com

Also, don't forget to leave a Steam Review if you've been enjoying your experience. It's been almost 6 months on Steam and we're lucky enough to have a 100% positive rating as of writing this, which totally blows our minds. Thank you all so very much for your continued support! ːslayawayaxeː

Sincerely,
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/17269971cc4c0b87fc406c20eb82a46f08755606.png[/img]
Skullface & The Slayaway Camp Team

PS. Almost forgot! For those who purchased the Deluxe Edition DLC (Soundtrack, papercrafts, etc) we have included a papercraft Batprince in the folder with the other papercrafts :) Enjoy!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/540730/

notes.title: THE "LOVE IS LIKE A MACHETE" UPDATE (v1.4)
notes.content:
Hey Killers!

We've got a brand new update for Slayaway Camp which brings a tonne of great fixes and updates, 

[h1]NEW CONTENT & FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Unlockable Gorepack: Freefallin’ - Killer takes Victim on a sweet skydiving bro-trip.
[*] Checkmarks in the pause menu have been redesigned to be a much much nicer checkmark. Revel in the beauty that is the all-new checkmark!
[*] Added some super sweet up/down arrows in the movie store, to get you up/down shelves easier. :) 
[*] Added a checkmark underneath a movie if you have completed it. We’re working on additional notifiers if the movie’s deleted scenes and NC17 levels are complete, but that will have to come in a future update.
[*] If language is French / keyboard layout is AZERTY, we use ZQSD instead of WASD for movement. Arrow keys still work too, so just use those you silly camper killers. [*] Laid some hot & sweaty groundwork for the FREE “My Gory Valentine” DLC movie to come out on Tuesday, in celebration of the iOS release!!! 
[*] We've also added brand new "My Gory Valentine" papercrafts to the Deluxe Edition Papercraft folder!
[/list]

[h1]BUGS FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the amount of time the “Game Over” credit sequence plays so you have time to dig through that drawer in the kitchen for your favorite lighter, spark it up and hold it over your head, waving it gently back and forth in time to the music.
[*] Steam was not checking for certain achievements when the game started up. We’ve taken Steam out to the garage, tied it up in a chair, sprinkled doritos on the floor, told it that if it doesn’t start checking for certain achievement when it launches Slayaway Camp that it will be forced to walk barefoot on those doritos. Steam now checks for certain achievements when the game starts up.
[*] Should have prevented future Linux / OSX Save games from resetting. If you notice your game has been reset in a past update, feel free to get in touch, chances are its still on your system, just in a folder named “Slayaway Camp” instead of a folder called “slayaway camp” apparently letter capitalization is a big deal in Linux, and I respect it for that.
[*] Made some of the ‘Tutorial hint’ things more clear / easier to read, etc.
[*] Background music was turning off after cutscenes. This broke GNÜ TRUNTIONS collective heart. It no longer does this. Rock on GNÜ TRUNTION, Rock on.
[*] Blue Wizard / Staff credits didnt show up when you completed the game anymore. This has been resolved so now you can see exactly who made this game, when you finish every puzzle, of course.
[*] Sometimes game would get stuck after dying to fire on Movie 2 Deleted Scene “Ritual Gone Wrong” this seems like it would have been part of said ritual that had gone wrong, and therefore a perfect sort of meta-joke, but we fixed it because it wasn’t actually intentional, despite the abundance of ironic humour.
[*] Texture and Audio optimizations which should help with performance on older systems, but still look super fly on newer ones.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/e7367d30bb000a80a60e0f1bc80f014f10fae638.gif[/img]

Get Ready!! On Valentines Day, we will be unveiling the brand new movie "My Gory Valentine" on your video shelves, which boasts a tonne of new puzzle levels, a new killer (Major Miner) and new kill animations. We'll remind you on Valentines Day when it's ready to play!

Happy Slaying,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/17269971cc4c0b87fc406c20eb82a46f08755606.png[/img]
Skullface & the Slayaway Camp Team

notes.title: THE "WORLD TRAVELLER" UPDATE (v.1.3.0)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/553e8f136951fc8390ba6d6caab06649d3faa75b.gif[/img]

Hey Killers! 

We've been very busy and are proud to announce some very big things for Slayaway Camp: localization & a mobile version! We've been focussed on iOS and are prepping for our big launch on the Apple App Store next month, with the Android version to follow soon afterwards. In celebration of the mobile launch we're going to be releasing a whole new movie's worth of Slayaway Camp goodness: New Levels, More Deleted Scenes & NC-17 Levels, A Brand New Special Killer, plus Awesome New Gorepacks & Bonus Kills! 

The best part is, this brand new movie, called "My Gory Valentine", will be available FOR FREE for all you girls and guys as a thanks for your amazing support! "My Gory Valentine" will become available the same day we're launching on iOS: Valentine's Day! We'll have more news on it in the next couple weeks, including a sneak peak at the new killer & theme. :)

Now... let's talk about what's in today's update!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/565950f98bbf30dce7a83d6152a4332179c923b4.gif[/img]

[h1]Glorious New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've translated the game to a few new languages: French, German, Russian, Spanish should now get fully localized variations of all our horrible, horrible puns!
[*] Subtitles on the intro cutscenes, and the ability to turn them off in the pause menu. 
[*] Your Gorepack collection just got a lot bigger! We've added gorepacks for all the 'Standard' kill animations you see when just starting the game. 
[*] We've also added Gorepacks for every boss kill you unlock. Just beat a movie to unlock that movie's boss Gorepack.
[*] We've also added Gorepacks for every special Killer Kill. Just unlock a killer with a special kill, and their Gorepack will also appear on the shelf. More killer special kills to come in future updates!
[*] With all these Gorepacks, it can get a little unruly, so you can now disable Gorepacks which you would not like to appear in-game. Boss Gorepacks can't be disabled, since they are tied directly to the puzzle itself.
[*] New On-Map non-cutscene quick kills.
[*] New Bonus Kills added: Piranha Pool, Telephone, Brain Surgery
[*] New water trap / drowning animations added: Piranhas, Crocodile, & Giant Clam
[*] If you're bothered by the blood (you might be playing the wrong game...) you can turn the blood/gore settings to off in the pause menu and it will also disable blood and gore in cutscenes.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The skip button is no longer invisible on Santa's Slay NC17 shower cutscene and Space Camp's NC17 shower cutscene.
[*] "Need a hint" tutorial no longer appears if the game is paused.
[*] Fixed issue with some NC17 levels displaying incorrect turn count after viewing the walkthrough.
[*] Fixed a bug where going through a teleporter and into an electric fence could cause a game freeze.
[*] Movie complete music now correctly plays at the completion of Movie 3.
[*] NC17 button should now be easier to select.
[*] Game would sometimes freeze after viewing a special killer kill under certain conditions.
[*] Skip button no longer overlaps subtitles on Intro scenes.
[*] Graphical fixes when highlighting icons on shelf scene.
[*] Improvements to shelf swiping.
[*] Hover color in pause menu changed to yellow to improve readability.
[*] Minor fixes to sliders in pause menu.
[*] Minor localization fixes.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[*] Minor graphical fixes.
[*] Minor text fixes.
[*] Various optimizations for UI and localization.
[/list]

Happy Slaying, Everyone! ːskullfaceː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/17269971cc4c0b87fc406c20eb82a46f08755606.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/f95858e6a876501e173676e27c91a3d61005487c.png[/img]

Hey Killers! Hope you've been having fun with Santa's Slay and all the goodies it brings! If you haven't checked it out, here's a link to check it out! Wanted to give a loving Skullface shout out to Pennie, who did the amazing fan art we featured above! Check out Pennie's Deviant Art page @ http://slimy-pennies.deviantart.com/ for more of her awesome work!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/559670/

[h1]MONTHLY MURDERER CLUB[/h1]

We'll be sending out the new KILLER KODE for the monthly murderer very soon (within the hour!), so make sure you're signed up to the Monthly Murderer Club (the Slayaway Camp Mailing List). 

Here's a link you can use to sign up right now, if you're not already signed up: http://www.slayawaycamp.com/mmclub

We send the killer code out via the mailing list on the third Friday of every month (that's today!) with a new killer exclusive to people who have the KODE, keep an eye out for it!

We've also made a bunch of bug fixes and updates to the game in the past couple weeks. Here's a full list of what you can expect the next time you start up Slayaway Camp!

[h1]FIXES & UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Movie Intro Cutscenes now have subtitles in case you're not sure what that gravelly voice of Mark Meer is saying. You can disable subtitles from the pause menu.
[*] Zoom tutorial now shows correct text when controller is plugged in
[*] Backup feature for save games (When loading a new version / updated version of the game, your save game will be duplicated to a backup file in your Application Data / AppData folder just in case something happens, you can restore to your old file. 
[*] Killers are now sorted more betterer/more ocd-friendly on the killer shelf
[*] Fixed issue where you could not scroll to the bottom of the pause menu.
[*] Emoji bubbles now appear in front of killer faces where they should be, instead of behind them where they shouldn't be.
[*] Fixed occasional freeze caused by missing bonus kills on Santa's Slay
[*] SFX now mutes properly when entering killer code if SFX is set to mute in menu
[*] Fixed a bug where blood would remain on-screen after rewinding after editing blood settings in menu
[*] Fixed a bug where selecting the Intro Cutscene via blue menu in Santa's Slay would cause a freeze. Thanks to powermad24 for reporting and for his patience whilst we fixed it up :)
[*] Gorepack prices are now displaying correctly in their tooltips
[*] Changes to the Hint Tutorial popup so it's a little nicer to look at.
[*] FOK3 text description is no longer hidden
[*] Fixed bug where pausing while being killed caused unusual idle animations
[*] Minor text fixes
[*] Minor bug fixes
[*] Minor graphical fixes
[*] Minor UI fixes
[*] Over 10 bubble teas were consumed during these fixes.
[/list]

[h1]COMING SOON[/h1]

We've been doing a lot of work on a couple big things in the background and will have proper announcements coming soon, but to leave you with some tidbits: we've got a few more languages localized and will be able to implement that soon enough, and we also have been working hard on getting an iOS version done, and are almost ready to start beta testing it again. If you want to be part of the iOS beta, make sure you're on the mailing list and we'll send out more info on that soon! Join the mailing list at www.slayawaycamp.com :) 

Happy Slaying! ːskullfaceː

notes.title: THE "NIGHT(S) BEFORE CHRISTMAS" UPDATE (v1.1)
notes.content:
Hey Killers!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/ef2ef3757d386b5a4a856191a62b08457d6a2886.jpg[/img]

You may have noticed we have a brand new update to Slayaway Camp today! A lot of the update is preparation for the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/559670/]Santa's Slay Expansion Pack[/url] which officially launches in just a couple short days, but there are also a huge stack of fun goodies and updates that you can enjoy today on your puzzle, er... excursions...

As always we appreciate all your amazing feedback, reviews, forum comments, screenshots, videos and more!

[h1]NEW FEATURES![/h1]
[list]
[*] We decorated the video store. We do hope you enjoy the extent of our holiday spirit.
[*] Viewing a Gorepack now shows a random victim, instead of the same dude every time. He got tired of getting slaughtered over and over so we made it a priority to switch it up and give him a break.
[*] Skullface's hair finally started growing back! Hey.... He's actually kinda cute!
[*] Setup a system for more interesting Killer possibilities. You should be seeing some cool new killers soon enough!
[*] Shelf scene shows the Movie name after selecting a movie.
[*] If replaying a level that you've already beat, we used to not give the bonus kill screen after finishing the level. We've changed this so if you do replay a level, you get another chance at a bonus kill, only this time the coins rewarded are about half of what they were originally. This is a nice way to continue to get coins even though you've already beat levels.
[*] More than everything else, we've got everything setup for the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/559670/]Santa's Slay Expansion Pack[/url], so if you have $2 laying around & want to get some holiday slaying done, be sure to pick that up this Wednesday!
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/559670/

[h1]BUGS FIXED![/h1]
[list]
[*] SWAT Cops were shooting you in the back even after you teleported away. Unfair! Now teleporters let you escape, just as they should :)
[*] NC17 Boss Levels were not being marked "Green" / complete. This was a huge bummer especially if it was a level that took a long while to solve and you wanted to show off that you completed all the levels (or NC17 levels) in a movie. It now gets marked green / complete. :) 
[*] An NC17 level was still completable after you had died on the level. This was super tricky but was resolved so it can no longer occur.
[*] A bunch of minor graphical and design bugs were resolved to help keep things looking shiny and new.
[*] A few minor gameplay / level specific bugs were dealt with in order to make sure you aren't interrupted from weirdness while you solve those puzzles. :) 
[/list]

As always.. Happy Slaying! ːskullfaceːːslayawayaxeː

P.S. Person with the best Christmas horror story (short and sweet is best tho) will receive a FREE Santa's Slay Steam key you can use to unlock the Expansion pack TODAY! Just leave a comment below and we'll pick the winner with the best story by 9:00pm PST!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/559670/

notes.title: THE ‘DEADLY BLESSING’ UPDATE (v1.08)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/66e4bb80a0c9cfc3ecc91402129d25e6c0dff5e4.jpg[/img]

Hey Killers! ːslayawayknifeː

Just wanted to let you know while EVERYONE ELSE was either flipping out or cheering heartily about the voting results of some sort of Electrical College something or other (sounds pretty deadly, but we’ve got a game to make, people), we were hard at work plugging away on cool new updates for Slayaway Camp. Here’s a list of what you can find in the latest version!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/12cdebc0c87fbeac071da2a14e7ef99d1689b3a3.jpg[/img]

[h1]UPDATES MADE[/h1]
[list]
[*] We’ve made it a little easier to grind for extra Skull Coins with a couple very important changes. 1) You now get 10 coins for every kill in Faces of Killed 3. This means if you only kill one victim, you will still get 10 coins. Previously you had to reach tiers, meaning you would only get 50 coins if you reached 5 kills, then only get 50 coins until you reach 10 kills, at which point you’d get 100… etc. Now 1 kill = 10 coins, 2 kills = 20 coins, etc. ALSO if you reach a certain streak of kills you will begin getting double coins (20) for every kill, so it pays to do well! We’ve also optimized some of the Faces of Killed animations so they should be a bit smoother / not affect your accuracy when animating the kill bar. COINS!!! 
[*] You know how sometimes you get stuck on a puzzle but you don’t want to cheat and use the walkthrough for the puzzle, but you also can’t really figure it out so you leave the game and go make spaghetti or something, then you think of the answer to the puzzle because you can’t stop thinking about it? Well now you can just skip the level (using the FFWD button) instead of making spaghetti, and come back to complete the level later. While this does mean you won’t be making spaghetti, it does mean you can continue solving puzzles that might be a little easier and the resulting brain massage might give you new ideas on how to solve the previous puzzle! We made it so you can’t skip “boss” puzzles (the final puzzle in every movie) since those ones are supposed to be hardcore and if you can’t do it it just means you need to TRY HARDER! Or you can always get the hint ;) 
[*] You know how you buy a Gorepack from the shop shelf and it sits there all shiny on your shelf looking cool, but not much else until you actually play a puzzle and hope that random Gorepack comes up? Well now Gorepacks can be previewed from your Gorepack shelf. So you can watch them with your friends over and over until you DIE FROM LAUGHING.
[*] If you pause the game when playing with a gamepad, you should see nice little gamepad prompt showing you what gamepad buttons control what on-screen options. Its helpful and they go away if you un-pause.
[*] Menu text now appears highlighted on menus when tooltips are disabled. Minor bug. Was annoying.. now fixed.
[*] Sometimes you’d be playing a beach level and you’d get a weird alien guy as your bonus kill. It was weird. Aliens should only appear if you’re in space. Now Weird victims no longer appear during bonus kills. It’s not as weird anymore. Though I guess the concept of a bonus kill is a little weird in itself…
[*] We fixed a few bugs that appeared on the super hardcore NC17 levels. Only the super hardcore players will care about this. 
[*] A handful of minor bug fixes. Only a handful of minor players will care about this.
[/list]

[h1]OH![/h1]

If you’re browsing the menu, you might see a cool new menu option called “Killer Code”… We’re super sinister, so we’re not even going to tell you what that’s about until the next update! But…. if you’re interested and are worried you might be making spaghetti when we announce it, be sure to sign up to our mailing list at www.slayawaycamp.com — it’s a new feature we’ll be announcing very very soon and I promise you gals and guys will want to be involved from the very start :)

[h1]HELP US HELP YOU[/h1]

Also don’t forget to leave a review on Steam if you like what we’re doing. It goes a long long way when telling other people that you think the game is awesome! If you don’t think it’s awesome… well, just tell us why and we can make it more awesome for you!!!

Happy Slaying! ːskullfaceː

notes.title: THE "INFERNO" UPDATE (v1.03)
notes.content:
Hey Killers, 

Made some quick fixes for a few things that were causing us to lose some sleep. We wanted to get some of this technical stuff out of the way so we could focus on finishing up a proper FUN update for Halloween (Coming soon!) with a few new kill animations and an awesome new Halloween killer.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/47673ba88d353f93a7cb70e3e5bfc63a0d55e8f0.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW(ish) CONTENT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ok ok ok it's not really new but by popular demand we have added FLAC formatted audio files to the Official Game Soundtrack in the DLC Pack. You should just have to exit out of Steam and restart it for the DLC to download the extra FLAC files in the soundtrack folder, now.
[/list]

[h1]BUGS FiXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue that was causing the above NC17 (Super Challenge Mode) level to be totally unbeatable. Some poor mime was standing in the fire for an eternity, dead eyes staring out at the cold, empty world around him as his silent cells slowly crispified. It was fun to watch him not react to being engulfed in flames forever, but it also meant you couldn't beat the level, which was sad for Jessi and she asked me to upload the patch as soon as humanly possible so no one gets stuck for too long.
[*] Moar gamepad fixes have been implemented. Things should be getting smoother - still a few things we need to work out but hopefully this is a nice improvement.
[*] If you paused the game while a victim is escaping the level, it created a tear in the space time continuum, which led to the victim's DNA being scrambled with a piece of toast's DNA (wait does toast have DNA? Maybe a piece of living toast like a toast-man or something does...). Oh also the level would crash. Anyways this doesn't happen anymore, so don't even worry about whether or not toast has DNA, it has been made irrelevant at least in this specific context.
[*] More general tweaks and fixes to improve your play experience. They are so minor and rare that you probably didn't even realize they were there. That didn't stop us from standing behind the programmers' chairs and smacking them in the head with a bag full of orange juice soaked paper towels until these bugs were fixed, though. Believe you me.
